brief.title: Will Tram finish in the Top 3 of BBNaija Season 11?⁠

rule.text: Resolve YES, if Resolves to YES if Tram finishes 1st, 2nd, or 3rd place in the official BBNaija Season 11 finale results on Oct 4, 2026. Resolves to NO if he finishes 4th or lower. Source: Africa Magic broadcast.. Else resolve NO.
